bodyZh: 四根横撑围住凳脚，中间留空，换鞋时刚好可以把拖鞋推到座面下。
author: Mina
bodyEn: Four rails meet under a square seat. I kept the sides open so a pair of shoes can slide underneath.

bodyZh: 表盘做得很素，两条直指针隔着一张桌子也看得清。放在显示器旁边，现在抬眼就能看时间，不用总去摸手机。
author: Ivo
bodyEn: I kept the dial plain so the two straight hands stay readable from across the desk. It sits by my monitor and I actually check it instead of reaching for my phone.

bodyZh: 底座稍微往后仰，整叠日历纸就能自己立住，顶部用两个金属线圈把纸页夹在一起。我把它放在烧水壶旁边，随手记下倒垃圾的日子和什么时候该喂酵种。
author: Mina
bodyEn: The base tilts back a little so the page block stands up on its own, and two wire loops hold the sheets at the top. I keep it by the kettle to scribble down bin day and when the sourdough needs feeding.

bodyZh: 灯罩落在十字撑上，暖光沿下沿散下来。底座只占桌角一小块，旁边还能摊开笔记本。
author: Rae
bodyEn: The shade sits on a cross brace, leaving a ribbon of warm light at its lower edge. The small base leaves room for an open notebook.

bodyZh: 小圆槽围着椭圆底面排开。我会留一格空着，专门调当天的天空灰。
author: Bo
bodyEn: A cluster of small wells follows the oval. I would leave one free for mixing whatever grey the sky happens to be.

bodyZh: 底座比胶卷宽，前面留一小段切口。想把它放在收纳包装纸的抽屉边。
author: Mina
bodyEn: I extended the base past the roll and left the cutter just in front. It could sit in the corner of the wrapping-paper drawer.

bodyZh: 厚木底座托着转盘，黄铜铭牌藏在前侧偏下的位置，把目光留给唱针。
author: Jun
bodyEn: A thick wooden plinth anchors the spinning record. The little brass plate sits low on the front, away from the tonearm.

bodyZh: 几根竖着的小管共用一块宽底座。一管插一枝，从侧面正好能看见茎。
author: Lou
bodyEn: Upright tubes share one broad foot. A clipping in each tube would leave the stems visible from the side.

bodyZh: 矮底板两端立着挡板，中间夹书。最常翻的那本，我会放在靠边的位置。
author: Pip
bodyEn: Two upright ends frame the books on a low base. The one I reach for most would go right by the end.

bodyZh: 桥面搭在两端的矮岸之间。转到侧面看，矮栏杆把短短几步衬得像一段小路。
author: Noor
bodyEn: The deck spans between two low banks. Viewed from the side, the rail makes the short crossing feel like a longer walk.

bodyZh: 台面底下给键盘留了空。想摊开速写本的时候，就把键盘往里推。
author: Lou
bodyEn: The platform spans a clear space for a keyboard. I like the idea of sliding it back there before opening a sketchbook.

bodyZh: 一圈挡边把托盘围起来。泡茶的时候，我最缺的就是这样一块能顺手搁小勺的地方。
author: Cleo
bodyEn: The raised rim runs around the whole tray. It is just the sort of thing I'd want beside a teapot with nowhere to put the spoon.

bodyZh: 几本书依次落在搁板上，最外边留了点空位，给下一本带回家的口袋书。
author: Ivo
bodyEn: The books settle one at a time along the ledge. The open end leaves a spot for whichever paperback comes home next.

bodyZh: 细灯杆托着敞口圆筒灯罩，边缘换了一层色调，从上方看轮廓更清楚。
author: Bo
bodyEn: The open cylinder of the shade sits up on a slim pedestal. I kept its rim in a different tone to make the top easy to pick out.

bodyZh: 几颗挂钉从面板上伸出来，彼此间留着空。我想在相邻的两个位置挂钥匙和备用发圈。
author: June
bodyEn: A few pegs project from the board, leaving open space around them. I would put keys and a spare hair tie on neighbouring hooks.

bodyZh: 浅浅的一圈挡边让铅笔停在桌角，薄本子和零碎小物也能各占一处。
author: Kai
bodyEn: A low lip keeps a pencil from rolling across the desk. The notebook and small objects fit without piling on top of each other.

bodyZh: 我把接灰盘拉成一条细长的浅槽，细香可以稍微往后靠，灰就顺着落进去不乱飞。放在窗台上，晚饭后点一根刚好。
author: Pip
bodyEn: I stretched the ash plate into a long shallow trough so a thin stick can lean back and drop its ash without scattering. It sits by the window ledge where I burn one stick after dinner.

bodyZh: 我把塔身做得窄一点，接盘边缘留得很低，骰子不容易蹦出去。平时就放在桌游盒旁边的架子上，晚上随手掷两把很方便。
author: Otto
bodyEn: I kept the tower slim and gave the landing tray a low lip so dice don't skitter off the edge. It lives on the shelf next to our game box for quick rolls on weeknights.

bodyZh: 音条顺着两根支撑逐渐变短，哪怕还没有敲响，也能看出一点节奏。
author: Cleo
bodyEn: The bars step down in size across a pair of supports. Their different lengths make a rhythm you can see before playing a note.

bodyZh: 几道浅槽并排朝同一方向。我想把签字笔和钢笔紧挨着放，伸手就能换。
author: Lin
bodyEn: The shallow channels run in the same direction. I'd leave the felt-tip next to the fountain pen so I can grab either without looking.

bodyZh: 两个圈做得比底座宽一点高一点，折好的纸巾就不会塌下来。放在灶台边上，专门夹擦手用的厨房纸。
author: Sam
bodyEn: I made the hoops a little taller than the base is wide so folded napkins don't flop over. It sits by the stove holding the paper towels I wipe my hands on.

bodyZh: 颜色更深的下抽屉拉出来更多，上抽屉只露出一截，放在书桌边看起来挺稳。
author: Em
bodyEn: The deep-coloured lower drawer opens wider than the upper one. That bit of asymmetry helps the little cabinet feel grounded.

bodyZh: 短支脚把蜡烛稍稍抬高，烛芯换了个更深的颜色，隔着桌子也能一眼看到。
author: Ivo
bodyEn: A short foot lifts the candle above its flat base. I picked a contrasting colour for the wick so it reads from across the desk.

bodyZh: 两片宽圆边夹住一道道绕线的纹路。我想先拿厨房里的那卷棉线试试。
author: Noor
bodyEn: Two wide flanges surround the banded barrel. A short length of kitchen twine would be the first thing I'd try on it.

bodyZh: 上下两层错开一小块窗光，上面摆花盆，下面还能放浇水壶或一块叠好的布。
author: Lin
bodyEn: Two levels give the pot its own patch of light. The lower shelf can catch a watering can or a folded cloth.

bodyZh: 我把两根立柱稍微加宽了一点，小卡片放上去不容易晃，展示挡边也加深了，斜靠一张明信片正好卡住。我这个放在厨房台面上，夹着购物清单和一张照片。
author: Rae
bodyEn: I widened the twin uprights a touch so small cards don't wobble, and gave the display ledge a deeper lip to catch a postcard at a lean. Mine lives on the kitchen counter holding a shopping list and a photo.

bodyZh: 几个带盖小罐并排放在窄搁板上，罐盖的颜色串在一起。我习惯把盐放在最靠炉灶的那一端。
author: Cleo
bodyEn: A line of jars sits on a narrow shelf; the lids pull the colour scheme together. I'd keep the salt at the end closest to the stove.

bodyZh: 横板先归位，书和盒子最后横着推进去。故意留空一格，给第二天桌上冒出来的小东西。
author: Remy
bodyEn: The horizontal shelves go in first. Books and boxes slide in last, leaving one cubby open for whatever lands on the desk.

bodyZh: 我把两根挂柱错开高度，短一点的戒指就不会被高的挡住。放在洗手池边，专门搁洗手前摘下来的戒指。
author: June
bodyEn: I staggered the peg branches at different heights so shorter rings don't get lost behind the tall ones. It sits by the bathroom sink for the rings I take off before washing my hands.

bodyZh: 几片圆垫叠起来，每片边缘都露出一线颜色。水壶边就适合放这样一摞。
author: Otto
bodyEn: A stack of coloured discs leaves a stripe around each edge. I'd keep these next to the kettle for the first cup of the day.

bodyZh: 横纹沿着筒壁绕开，几支常用的笔可以摆在手边。
author: Mina
bodyEn: A banded cup keeps a few sketching tools together.

bodyZh: 竖杆上搭了一根短横杆，顶部用了撞色。想给耳机留个地方，线就不用绕着键盘放了。
author: Lin
bodyEn: A short bar sits across the stem with a contrasting pad on top. I wanted somewhere to leave headphones without coiling their cable around the keyboard.

bodyZh: 靠背往后斜了一点，手机立着刚好能瞄一眼菜谱。我把它放在水壶旁边，煮咖啡时计时器就在手边。
author: Sam
bodyEn: The backrest leans back just enough that the phone stays upright while I glance at a recipe. I keep it by the kettle so the timer is right there while the coffee brews.

bodyZh: 按大小把信分开放，最矮的挡板在前面。
author: Rae
bodyEn: The upright dividers separate mail by size.

bodyZh: 我把竖隔板做成阶梯状，高一点的信封能斜靠回去，不会软塌塌地倒下来。我把它放在门口收账单和这一周攒下的信件。
author: Noor
bodyEn: I staggered the upright dividers so taller envelopes lean back at an angle and don't flop over. Mine sits by the door for bills and the mail that piles up during the week.

bodyZh: 筒口留得很干净，横纹集中在下方。想给总钻到本子下面的那几支笔找个家。
author: Rae
bodyEn: A smooth lip above a few bands keeps the silhouette simple. I'd use it for the three pencils that always end up under my notebook.

bodyZh: 胶卷和小切口相对，底下是同一块底座。
author: Jun
bodyEn: The roll and cutter share one base.

bodyZh: 一片蜂蜜色圆盘架在细灯杆上，顶端露出一颗白色小圆帽，像老收音机上的旋钮。底座也用了圆盘，把上下面的形状呼应起来。
author: Lou
bodyEn: One warm disc sits on a narrow stem. A white cap peeks over it like the button on an old radio. I kept the base wide enough to echo the shade.

bodyZh: 想利用进门旁边那一小截墙。四条细腿间留出两层灰绿色搁板，浅色桌面只要能搁下钥匙和当天的信就够了。
author: Sam
bodyEn: A narrow console for the bit of hallway just inside the door. Two grey-green shelves sit between the tall legs. The lighter top is just deep enough for keys and the day's post.

bodyZh: 两根直指针压在圆表面上，放床头也能看清。
author: Noor
bodyEn: Two straight hands stand out against a round dial.

bodyZh: 手机抵住前沿，向后靠在支撑上，适合翻菜谱。
author: Ivo
bodyEn: The front lip leaves the phone leaning on its backrest.

bodyZh: 把耳机横放在撑杆上，桌面就能空出来。
author: Kai
bodyEn: A raised bar gives the headband its own spot.

bodyZh: 圆垫依次叠起，侧面露出一道道边缘。
author: Cleo
bodyEn: The stacked discs show their edges in a narrow stripe.

bodyZh: 矮底板两头立着挡板，正好放下一排小册子。
author: Em
bodyEn: Upright ends frame books on a low strip.

bodyZh: 小横杆一层层错开，摘下来的戒指有地方放。
author: Lin
bodyEn: Short branches place rings at different heights.

bodyZh: 几排圆槽落在椭圆盘上，留一格专门调灰色。
author: Remy
bodyEn: Small circular wells follow an oval base.

bodyZh: 带盖的小罐在窄台上排成一行。
author: Bo
bodyEn: A row of lidded jars sits along a narrow rail.

bodyZh: 竖管共用一块底座，每管可以插一枝。
author: Pip
bodyEn: Several tubes rise from a broad foot for individual cuttings.

bodyZh: 两根立柱间架着一条横托，可以摆明信片。
author: Lou
bodyEn: A ledge across the uprights makes space for a card.

bodyZh: 两端的圆片夹着中间绕线的纹路。
author: Jo
bodyEn: Wide end discs frame the ribbed barrel.

bodyZh: 页块搁在底座上，两道圈扣住顶端。
author: Sam
bodyEn: A block of pages sits beneath two binding loops.

bodyZh: 烛身落在小碟中，细支脚把碟面托高。
author: Mina
bodyEn: A short stem raises the candle above a footed dish.

bodyZh: 两侧的圆环把餐巾托起来，方便抽取。
author: Rae
bodyEn: Two hoops keep the paper napkins standing.

bodyZh: 平行的槽道让常用的笔并排放好。
author: Jun
bodyEn: Parallel channels give each pen a separate spot.

bodyZh: 塔口正对一块矮挡边的托盘，骰子有地方落。
author: Noor
bodyEn: The tower opens onto a shallow landing tray.

bodyZh: 一支细香伸到长盘上方，盘面用来承灰。
author: Ivo
bodyEn: A slender stick extends above the long ash plate.

bodyZh: 几排短挂钉从面板伸出，钥匙可以各挂一处。
author: Kai
bodyEn: Small pegs project from a flat backing.

bodyZh: 敞口的圆筒灯罩架在细杆上，适合放书桌边。
author: Cleo
bodyEn: An open cylindrical shade rests on a slim stem.

bodyZh: 托盘四周绕着一圈围边，正好收住零碎小物。
author: Em
bodyEn: A continuous rim outlines the shallow tray.

bodyZh: 台面整体抬高，底下留了放键盘的空间。
author: Lin
bodyEn: A raised platform leaves a clear space below.
